title: Vehicle recall intake
text: Check the full vehicle identification number against the open safety recall database. Record the campaign and route the vehicle to an authorized repair facility.

title: Service scheduling
text: Book a routine oil and filter change by odometer mileage. Confirm the engine variant and send the service appointment time to the owner.

title: Wholesale vehicle shipment
text: Record the bill of lading and confirm that the correct vehicle is loaded on the dealer transport truck for shipment.

title: Machine lockout during maintenance
text: Isolate all energy feeds before entering the machine enclosure. Apply personal lockout tags and verify that the electrical and pneumatic systems have no stored energy.

title: Dimensional quality inspection
text: Check machined parts against tolerance with a calibrated micrometer. Record readings by lot number and quarantine parts outside specification.

title: Assembly line shift handoff
text: Record the work in progress, jam locations, estimated output and missing materials for the incoming production supervisor.

title: Recorder playback and retention
text: When security camera clips disappear after reboot, check disk health, recording schedules, retention policy and whether the recorder clock is synchronized.

title: Retail emergency exit
text: Keep the route to each emergency exit clear of stock and carts. Check the exit sign, release hardware and door swing during the opening inspection.

title: Cash drawer reconciliation
text: Count the change float when closing shift. Compare tender totals and reconcile discrepancies before depositing receipts.
